name: seed-planned-located-e2e-only-coverage
body: seed_planned_located takes a live lbug Connection, so by the tier law it has no direct unit or int test; its coverage is the pinned e2e realization matrix planned_node_realizes_on_the_splice_for_every_kind. Upgrade only if a per-kind unit seam (an in-memory query abstraction) is introduced.
